articles.title: Brazil's central bank faces backlash over stablecoin money laundering remarks
articles.snippet: A central bank official reportedly said legitimate funds become tainted when moved into stablecoins, comparing the market to the informal "dólar-cabo" system.

articles.title: Trump administration to name Nvidia, OpenAI and several others as AI national champions
articles.snippet: The Wall Street Journal reported that the move aims to help the firms expand overseas and compete with global rivals, though nothing has been confirmed.

articles.title: Hackers inject credit card, crypto-stealing malware into 178 major websites
articles.snippet: Researchers say attackers compromised scripts delivered through Optimizely, exposing visitors to malware designed to replace crypto wallet addresses and steal payment card details.

articles.title: Safe wallet reportedly loses $6.5M as Zodiac suspects key compromise
articles.snippet: Zodiac’s co-founder said a likely compromised key and overly permissive wallet settings enabled the theft, rather than a flaw in its smart contracts.

articles.title: Lighter recovers $5M after $10M exploit linked to compromised API keys
articles.snippet: Lighter restored withdrawals after recovering approximately $5 million in USDC, while blockchain analysts traced $10.4 million in funds moved during the exploit.
